data.name: Dreadarion VR
data.detailed_description:
Fight. Solve. Survive.

Dreadarion is a PC VR survival horror game built in Unreal Engine 5 for players who demand more than jump scares. Explore a derelict villa, solve physical puzzles with your own hands, manage scarce resources, and fight to survive a nightmare rooted in an ancient story.

🕯️ The Story

Night after night, the same dream. A suffocating forest where the trees seem to watch. A derelict villa beyond a rusted gate, shrouded in an atmosphere older than memory.

The visions grow sharper — too detailed to be imagination. When you trace the fragments to a real location, you make the only choice you can: you go. But the moment you step inside, one thing becomes clear: this place already knows who you are. And it's been expecting you.

Why were you chosen? The answer is inside. But you may not want to find it.

🩸 Authentic Survival Horror

The dread here comes from something worse than jump scares: the slow, crushing realization that you are outmatched, under-resourced, and completely alone. Every corridor could be your last. Every locked door hides something you're not ready for.

✋ Total VR Physicality

Your body is your controller. Reload weapons by hand. Grip a knife and feel the weight of a decision. Flick open a lighter while something shifts just beyond the flame's reach. There are no button prompts, no shortcuts. When panic sets in — and it will — your own trembling hands become your greatest ally and your worst enemy.

🖥️ High-Fidelity PC VR Graphics

Built exclusively for PC-tethered VR, Dreadarion harnesses the full power of Unreal Engine 5 and desktop-class hardware. Every texture, every flicker of dying light, every reflection on a blood-stained surface is rendered at a level of fidelity most VR titles simply can't reach. When reality and nightmare become indistinguishable, true horror begins.

🎬 A Cinematic, No-Filler Campaign

Crafted with cinematic precision, Dreadarion pulls you in and never lets go. Every scene earns its place — no padding, no filler. Just a relentless spiral of tension that delivers a complete story and stays with you long after you remove your headset.

📜 The Environment Speaks

Scattered documents. Photographs of people who were here before you. Rooms staged like crime scenes frozen in time. Nothing is placed by accident — the world itself becomes the narrator, rewarding the curious with layers of lore that deepen the horror with every discovery.

🔫 Every Bullet Counts

You will never have enough. Not enough ammo. Not enough painkillers. Not enough time. Do you spend your last shell now — or save it for whatever you heard two rooms ahead? When you're down to your last magazine and the flashlight starts to flicker, you'll understand what real desperation feels like.

🔑 Key Features

  • Pure Survival Horror — Resource scarcity, tense combat, and an oppressive atmosphere

  • Full VR Physicality — Realistic reloading, hand-based puzzle solving, physical item interaction

  • Unreal Engine 5 Visuals — PC-exclusive graphics pushing the limits of VR fidelity

  • 3–4 Hour Cinematic Campaign — A lean, high-impact single-player experience with zero filler

  • Environmental Storytelling — Photos, documents, and meticulously designed spaces that reveal a dark narrative

  • Upgrade System — Use gold coins to enhance weapons, health, and abilities

  • Multiple Weapon Types — Pistol, SMG, Shotgun, and Desert Eagle, all designed for one-handed VR use

  • Collectibles & Secrets — Hidden items and destructible objects that reward exploration with lore and unlockable rewards

🥽 VR Support

Valve Index, HTC Vive, Meta/Oculus headsets via SteamVR, and all OpenXR/OpenVR-compatible devices are supported.

  • Locomotion: Smooth

  • Turning: Smooth turn / Snap turn

  • Comfort options: Vignette

  • Play space: Room-scale or standing recommended

It knows your name. You don't know why.
Yet.

🔖 Wishlist Dreadarion now — the answer is waiting inside.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RX 5600 XT / GeForce RTX 2060 / Intel ARC A580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3s, Meta Quest 3
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

content_descriptors.notes: This VR game features intense, first-person combat in a dark, poorly-lit, and eerie environment. Players wield melee weapons and firearms to fight enemies. Combat is accompanied by graphic blood effects and realistic corpses scattered throughout the environment. The game also contains frequent use of strong language. The overall atmosphere, combined with the gore and unsettling settings, may disturb sensitive players.
